candidate: NVFP4 experts using the unchanged deployed b11756 CUDA backend
control: IQ3_S gate/up and IQ4_NL down operators, not a different binary
purpose: Decide whether expert-only NVFP4 warrants an expensive model conversion; not model quality or whole-model performance validation.

patterns: one quarter spread and three quarters concentrated

correctness.reference: CPU operations on the same NVFP4-quantized tensors
correctness.cases: Six real-shape n512 cases plus m129/k256, n63/64/65, both broadcast layouts and all three routes
correctness.tolerance: Existing test_mul_mat_id backend tolerance, including NMSE 0.02 for Blackwell native FP4 activation quantization
correctness.does_not_establish: Equivalence to original model weights or preserved model quality

stop: Stop on correctness failure. Otherwise complete both performance orders and reject a candidate exceeding the regression limit; do not retune or select a favorable subset after measurement.
promotion: Only a passing operator screen may proceed to model conversion, independent precision/task-quality checks, matched end-to-end MTP and prefill confirmation, and release validation. No deployment in this screen.
attribution: NVFP4 CUDA kernels are existing upstream work. This experiment contributes local measurement and configuration/model feasibility evidence only.
